objective: Under G17 with G1, after TWO-EXCEPTIONS-20261127-001 and the cycle study's referee (which found capped cores that finish and one that repeats): for the starts whose node core passed the cap under the tree+ and grow weightings, certify without growing which cores finish (completed under a larger cap, or by the subset pattern: a rank whose births all share one parent ends after 2^m - m - 1 more births), which repeat (the parent incidence of one rank isomorphic to an earlier rank's, so Lemma R's round rule repeats forever), and which remain unresolved; count each class by weighting and size, so that how often a core is unending is stated with its weighting.
title: What the node cores over the cap are: finishing, repeating or growing without bound
